cookie.intro: As CYPILAN.COM, we use cookies to provide a better user experience to our visitors and to increase platform performance.
cookie.section1_body: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device or network server through your browser when you visit a website.
cookie.section2_essential: Mandatory Cookies: Required for basic site functions such as login, language preference and currency selection.
cookie.section2_performance: Performance and Analytics Cookies: Help us understand site usage statistics and improve its performance.
cookie.section3_body: If you wish, you can change your cookie preferences or block cookies completely in your browser settings. However, if mandatory cookies are blocked, some features of the site may not function fully.

faq.a1: Yes! Our individual users can post basic advertisements in Real Estate, Vehicles, Second Hand and all other categories completely free of charge. If you wish, you can take advantage of premium features such as "Showcase Ad" to sell or rent your ad faster.
faq.a2: Posting an ad is very easy! After creating a free account or logging in, you can choose your category by clicking the "Post an Ad" button in the upper right corner, add the ad title, photos and price information and publish your ad within minutes.
faq.a3: For your safety, we recommend that you make your payments face to face after seeing and testing the product. Never send an advance deposit or money order to people you do not know. For more detailed information, you can review our Security Tips page.
faq.a4: With our Corporate Membership packages offered specifically for real estate offices, car dealerships and commercial businesses, you will have advantages such as posting unlimited advertisements, opening a corporate store page with the company logo and benefiting from the priority support line.
faq.a5: For your questions, suggestions or complaints, you can reach us 7 days a week at info@cypilan.com or our support line +90 555 000 00 00.
faq.a6: You can only rate a member you have previously messaged; this rule exists to prevent fake reviews. You can leave one rating per member and update or delete it at any time. Ratings run from 1 to 5 stars and appear as an average on the seller profile.
faq.a7: No. Some features are still in development and are labelled "Coming Soon" in our promotions. You can see which features are live and which are on the way on the Coming Soon page.

privacy.intro: As CYPILAN.COM, we attach great importance to the security and privacy of your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data is collected, used and protected when you visit our website and use our services.
privacy.section1_body: When you register or post an ad, your name, e-mail address, phone number, location information and device login records are collected for service delivery purposes.
privacy.section2_body: Your personal data is processed for the purpose of publishing advertisements on our platform, ensuring user security, communicating and fulfilling legal obligations.
privacy.section3_body: Your data is not sold or shared with third party individuals or institutions for advertising/marketing purposes. It can only be shared with competent authorities in case of official requests by legal authorities.
privacy.section4_body: If you have questions about our privacy policy, you can contact us at info@cypilan.com.

safety.subtitle: Golden rules you should pay attention to for a safe trading experience.
safety.tip1_body: Never send money transfers to people you do not know under the name of prepayment, deposit or shipping fee. Complete your shopping after seeing and examining the product live.
safety.tip1_title: 1. Do Not Pay Without Seeing the Product
safety.tip2_body: Be careful to hold your meetings with the buyer or seller during daylight hours, in crowded and safe public areas (shopping malls, cafes, squares).
safety.tip3_body: Do not enter your passwords and card information into payment or cargo verification links (links) received from SMS or messaging applications.
safety.tip4_body: Report advertisements that offer unrealistic prices, contain deceptive information or shake your trust to our team by using the "Report" option on the advertisement detail page.
